in_text_mentions: A 36‐year‐old female at 40.6 weeks of gestation presented to the La Maná Health Center approximately 30 min after sustaining a Bothrops snakebite on her right ring finger (Figure 1). Initial laboratory studies revealed hemoglobin of 12.1 g/dL, a white blood cell count of 13,800/μL, and thrombocytopenia (92,000/μL).
